summary: Grace Therapeutics, Inc. filed an 8-K on June 18, 2026, solely to update its corporate presentation (Exhibit 99.1). The filing contains Item 8.01 (Other Events) and Item 9.01 (Exhibits) but discloses no special-situation corporate transaction, no M&A activity, no activist campaign, no tender offer, no strategic review, no going-private, no capital return, no spin-off, no rights offering, no restructuring, no liquidation, no delisting, no issuer tender, no deal termination, no SPAC event, and no management change. The update provides forward-looking statements regarding its GTx-104 program and FDA interactions. This is a routine current report with no transaction terms, no board recommendation, no advisor, and no special-structural mechanics.
